tasks.title: Find a product's price and stock
tasks.prompt: On the shop, find the product "Titanium Widget". What is its price and how many units are in stock? Answer in the form: price=$<price> stock=<units>

tasks.title: Cart, coupon, checkout through an iframe
tasks.prompt: Buy 2 × "Brass Sprocket" and 1 × "Titanium Widget" (nothing else). Apply the coupon code SAVE10 in the cart, then check out: full name Ada Lovelace, country Canada, Express shipping, test card 4242 4242 4242 4242, expiry 12/30, CVC 123. Place the order and report the order number.

tasks.title: Log in, find an order in a paginated table
tasks.prompt: Sign in with email demo@acme.test and password hunter2, then find the status of order A-1042 in your order history. Answer with the status text exactly as shown.

tasks.title: Read docs in a new tab, expand a collapsed FAQ
tasks.prompt: Using the shop's Docs (linked in the site header), find how many days customers have to return an item and what restocking fee applies to opened items. Answer in the form: days=<n> fee=<fee>

tasks.title: Support form inside an iframe
tasks.prompt: Open a support request on the shop's Support page with category Billing, priority High and the message: Charged twice for order A-1042. Submit it and report the ticket id.

tasks.title: Live web: log in and check out on a public demo shop
tasks.prompt: This is Sauce Labs' public demo shop for testing automation (no real payment). Log in with username standard_user and password secret_sauce, add the "Sauce Labs Backpack" to the cart, check out with first name Ada, last name Lovelace and postal code 10001, and finish the order. Report the confirmation heading shown after finishing and the order total from the overview page. Answer in the form: confirmation=<heading> total=$<total>
